privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.local: Your tasks and what Dhakerni learns about you stay on this device.
privacy.server: For reminders when the app is closed, our server keeps only your push address, an anonymous ID, the reminder time and a short title. It is encrypted and deleted right after the reminder fires.

task.reorderHelp: Press space to pick up, arrow keys to move, space to drop.
